data.name: Created
data.value: Goods receipt task was created and order quantities were reserved.

data.name: InvalidRequest
data.value: Goods receipt request is invalid.

data.name: SupplierNotFound
data.value: The selected supplier was not found in ERP mirror data.

data.name: WarehouseNotFound
data.value: The selected warehouse was not found in ERP mirror data.

data.name: ReceivingLocationNotFound
data.value: The selected receiving location was not found.

data.name: InvalidReceivingLocation
data.value: The receiving location must be active, belong to the selected warehouse, and be Receiving or Staging.

data.name: SourceOrderChanged
data.value: Netsis order data changed. Refresh orders and try again.

data.name: StockMirrorMissing
data.value: An order stock was not found in ERP mirror data. Run stock synchronization first.

data.name: YapMirrorMissing
data.value: An order YAP code was not found in ERP mirror data.

data.name: InvalidQuantity
data.value: Reserved quantity must be greater than zero.

data.name: QuantityExceedsAvailable
data.value: Requested quantity exceeds the current available order quantity.

data.name: InvalidAssignee
data.value: One of the selected task users is missing or inactive.

data.name: IdempotencyConflict
data.value: The same idempotency key cannot be reused for a different goods receipt request.

data.name: ConcurrencyConflict
data.value: Order quantity was changed by another operation. Refresh and try again.

data.name: LabelSplitInvalidRequest
data.value: Label split input is invalid. The split quantity must be greater than zero, less than the label quantity, and the reason must contain at least 3 characters.

data.name: LabelSplitNotFound
data.value: The label to split was not found.

data.name: LabelSplitAlreadyCompleted
data.value: This label has already been split. The original label cannot be reused; use the generated child labels.

data.name: LabelSplitUnavailable
data.value: A voided, split, or stock-unlinked label cannot be split.

data.name: LabelSplitSerialPerUnitBlocked
data.value: Stock {0} is tracked with a separate serial for every unit. A single serial/label cannot be split.

data.name: LabelSplitQuantityMismatch
data.value: The sum of child label quantities must equal the source label quantity.

data.name: LabelSplitCompleted
data.value: The label was split into two traceable child labels.

data.name: LabelVoidUnavailable
data.value: A voided label barcode cannot be used.
